'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Ganden Yanaga DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ganden Yanaga]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Cam Solusar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
